meta.note: This file is primarily generated for this academic project, written to be realistic and scale-consistent with a 50,000+ student, multi-faculty university. A few facts (marked verified_by_user) were already established as real earlier in this project — library timing, gym/swimming pool existence and subscription fees, and the on-campus hospital. A few facility details (marked sourced_from_prior_research, e.g. specific lab names) come from earlier self-flagged-uncertain research collected for this project and are repeated here for consistency, not re-verified. None of the generated or prior-research content should be treated as officially confirmed university information.

library.number_of_libraries: The university operates a Central Library along with dedicated faculty-specific libraries/reading rooms in major faculties (e.g. a Medical Library at the Faculty of Medicine, a Law Library at the Faculty of Law), consistent with the scale of a 25+ faculty university. (generated)
library.collection_size: The library collection includes an estimated 2,00,000+ books and subscriptions to 300+ national and international journals across disciplines. (generated)
library.digital_resources: Access to the National Digital Library of India (NDLI), DELNET inter-library network, and e-journal subscriptions, supported in part by the university's Springer Nature partnership referenced elsewhere in the knowledge base. (generated)
library.study_rooms: Dedicated silent study zones for individual study, along with separate bookable group discussion rooms for project/assignment work. (generated)
library.borrowing_limits_and_fines: Undergraduate students may typically borrow up to 3 books for 14 days; postgraduate/research students up to 5 books for 21 days. A late return fine (commonly a small per-day, per-book charge) applies beyond the due date. (generated)
library.silent_zones: The Central Library maintains designated silent study zones separate from group discussion areas to accommodate different study preferences. (generated)

food_courts_and_canteens.number_and_location: Multiple food courts and canteens are spread across campus zones, including locations near the hostels, central academic block, and faculty-specific areas (e.g. a dedicated canteen near the Faculty of Engineering and Technology), consistent with the scale of a 50,000+ student campus.
food_courts_and_canteens.veg_non_veg_availability: Most food courts offer a mix of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options; hostel mess dining itself is strictly vegetarian (as already documented), while campus food courts/canteens outside the hostel mess offer broader choices including non-vegetarian items.
food_courts_and_canteens.timing: Food courts are generally open from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM, with core canteens near hostels open slightly later to accommodate evening/night snacking.
food_courts_and_canteens.price_range: Approximately ₹40-₹150 per meal/snack item depending on the outlet and item, keeping options accessible for a large student population.
food_courts_and_canteens.outlets_present: A mix of university-run canteens and branded/franchise food outlets (common categories include a multi-cuisine food court, a fast-food/quick-bite outlet, a bakery/cafe-style outlet, and a South Indian/North Indian meal counter).

gym.subscription_fee: An additional subscription charge of ₹7,500 applies for gym usage. (verified)
gym.timing: Typically open from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM, with separate time slots for different user groups where required. (generated)
gym.trainer_availability: Certified fitness trainers are available during peak hours (commonly early morning and evening) to guide students on equipment usage and basic fitness plans. (generated)

swimming_pool.availability: The university has swimming pool facilities for student fitness and recreation. (verified)
swimming_pool.subscription_fee: An additional subscription charge of ₹3,500 applies for swimming pool usage. (verified)
swimming_pool.timing: Typically open from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, often with separate time slots for beginners/lesson batches versus free swim. (generated)
swimming_pool.safety_rules: Use of the pool typically requires appropriate swimwear, a mandatory shower before entry, and adherence to lifeguard instructions at all times; students with certain medical conditions may need prior clearance. (generated)
swimming_pool.swimming_lessons: Basic swimming lessons are generally available for beginners as part of the subscription, often coordinated through the sports department. (generated)

wifi_campus_wide.coverage: Wi-Fi coverage extends across academic blocks, library, hostels, and common outdoor areas, supporting the university's day-to-day digital learning needs.
wifi_campus_wide.speed_and_access: Shared high-speed broadband is provisioned per building/zone, sufficient for browsing, research, video-based learning, and video-call classes/meetings.
wifi_campus_wide.login_and_registration: Students receive Wi-Fi login credentials linked to their student ID/ERP account at the time of admission/orientation, with periodic password reset options through the student portal.

auditoriums_and_seminar_halls.capacity: The university has multiple auditoriums and seminar halls of varying capacity, ranging from smaller seminar halls (100-300 seats) to large auditoriums (1,000+ seats) suitable for convocations, cultural fests, and major events.
auditoriums_and_seminar_halls.booking_process: Student clubs/societies and department coordinators can request auditorium/seminar hall bookings through the Dean of Student Affairs office or the respective faculty administration, typically requiring advance notice for larger events.

smart_classrooms_and_labs.smart_classrooms: Smart classrooms equipped with digital projectors/smart boards and audio-visual systems are used across most faculties for lecture delivery. (generated)

smart_classrooms_and_labs.practical_learning_facilities: Related sources also describe '6 Practical Learning Facilities' including a Pragya Simulation Centre, a Mock Aircraft cabin, a Moot Court, a Fabrication Lab, a Film & Journalism Studio, and a Forensic Science Lab. smart_classrooms_and_labs.department_wise_labs: Each engineering/science department additionally maintains its own core subject labs (e.g. Electronics Lab, Chemistry Lab, Physics Lab, Microbiology Lab) required for the respective curriculum. (generated)

power_backup_coverage.coverage: Power backup (generator/UPS-based) covers critical infrastructure including hostels, library, computer labs, hospital, and academic blocks, ensuring minimal disruption during power outages.
power_backup_coverage.note: Full-capacity backup for high-load equipment (e.g. gym equipment, some lab machinery) may be limited compared to lighting/networking/computing loads.

cctv_and_security_coverage.coverage: CCTV surveillance is maintained across campus common areas, academic blocks, hostel common areas (as already documented), parking zones, and main entry/exit points.
cctv_and_security_coverage.security_personnel: 24/7 security personnel are posted at main gates and patrol key campus zones, coordinating with hostel wardens and the anti-ragging committee as needed.
cctv_and_security_coverage.id_card_access: Access to certain buildings/labs during off-hours may require student ID card verification at security checkpoints.

convenience_stores_and_shops.convenience_stores: General convenience/grocery stores are available near hostel zones for daily essentials.
convenience_stores_and_shops.stationery_and_photocopy: Stationery and photocopy/printing shops are available near academic blocks and the library, commonly used for assignment printing and book photocopying.
convenience_stores_and_shops.salon: On-campus salon/grooming services are available, typically located near the hostel zones.

atm_and_bank_branch.availability: An on-campus bank branch and multiple ATMs (of the university's primary banking partner and possibly others) are available for students, reducing the need to travel off-campus for basic banking needs.
atm_and_bank_branch.services: Typical on-campus branch services include student account opening assistance, scholarship/loan disbursement support, and standard banking transactions.
